about_tool_text: A complete defensive website audit: security, vulnerabilities, domain identity, servers and paths — no exploitation, no attacks.
authorize_prompt: Is this your own site, or do you have written authorization to test it? (yes/no)
back_hint: Press 0 to go back at any time, or type EXIT to quit.
confirm_state_change: This step performs a state-changing action on the target. Confirm?
console_welcome: Type help for the guide, or scan followed by a URL to start a scan.
cookies_note: Cookies are shown by name and flags only — values are never shown (session values are secrets).
deep_paths_note: Deep path probing needs authorization (your own site or written permission) — passive discovery results are above.
enter_ip: Enter the IP address (IPv4 or IPv6)
full_port_scan_warn: Full scan of all 65535 ports — takes minutes and is noisy. Your own site only, or with written permission.
help_about: About the tool and the developer
help_bare_url: Type the URL directly to scan it
help_scan: Big comprehensive scan of the site
help_tip: Tip: the audit is defensive only — no exploitation, no attacks.
history_note: Previous names and rename dates are not published by any free public source — the closest facts are the registration date and the earliest CT certificate.
how_to_steps: 1. Type scan followed by the site URL (or just the URL) — 2. Type y to accept the terms — 3. Read the detailed report — 4. Export JSON or HTML from the results dashboard.
invalid_choice: Invalid choice. Please enter a number from the menu.
invalid_ip: Invalid IP address. Please enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
invalid_url: Invalid URL. Please enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://
lab_warning: Laboratory only: harmless educational test samples. Nothing here is real malware.
no_scan_yet: No scan yet. Run a scan first (option 1).
not_authorized: Not authorized. This investigation needs explicit authorization for your own site or a site you have written authorization to test.
ports_need_auth: Port scanning needs authorization (your own site or written permission).
report_note: This module never downloads, stores or displays abuse content. It records safe incident metadata only, for lawful reporting.
results_saved: Results saved to the case file.
reverse_arabic: Reverse Arabic (for correct display in Termux)
shield_line: Protection mode: defensive audit only — no exploits
telegram_intro: Send the full report via Telegram (optional): enter your account ID and your bot token. The token is never saved.
terms_1: You are an ethical hacker: you audit only your own site, or a site you have written permission to audit.
terms_2: Defensive audit only: no exploitation, no login bypass, no attacks, no data theft.
terms_3: You are responsible for everything you do with this tool, under these terms and the law.
terms_4: Results are for securing and fixing only, and for official reporting when needed.
terms_accept: Do you agree to the terms and really want to continue? Type y to accept
terms_title: Terms of use — read before continuing
training_scan: Run a training scan on the lab
unknown_command: Unknown command — type help for the guide.
